```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(arrow)

theme_minimal_transparent <- function(sz = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = sz) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey30", margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey30", margin = margin(t = 15))
    )
}

apprehensions_latest <- read_parquet(

encounters_latest <- read_parquet(

encounters_edited <- encounters_latest |>
  mutate(
    title_of_authority = case_when(
      !is.na(statute_charge) ~ "Title 8",
      is.na(statute_charge) ~ "Title 42"
    )
  )

apprehensions_edited <- apprehensions_latest |>
  mutate(
    title_of_authority = case_when(
      !is.na(statute_charge) ~ "Title 8",
      is.na(statute_charge) ~ "Title 42"
    )
  )
```

## Intro

United States Border Patrol (USBP) releases apprehension and encounter data in separate sheets. While general encounters include all types of interactions at the border, Title 8 inadmissibles are recorded under the Office of Field Operations (OFO) rather than the USBP. Therefore, the USBP encounters datasets include only Title 8 apprehensions and Title 42 expulsions. On the other hand, USBP apprehensions data covers Title 8 apprehensions only.

Because intended difference between the USBP encounters datasets and the USBP apprehensions datasets is the pandemic-era Title 42 expulsions in the encounters dataset, we aim to consolidate encounters and apprehensions into one, comprehensive dataset that can be filtered depending on `title_of_authority`.

-   Simple logic:
    -   If `statute_charge` populated -\> `title_of_authority` = Title 8
    -   If `statute_charge` is missing -\> `title_of_authority` = Title 42

## Unique Value Exploration

To consolidate these apprehensions and encounters datasets, we attempt to use the `statute_charge` field to indicate whether an encounter is a Title 8 apprehension or Title 42 expulsion. First, we explore the unique values in this field. \*To be filled in after law student report?


```{r}

dat <- apprehensions_latest |>
  group_by(source_file, source_sheet) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            missing_statute_charge = sum(is.na(statute_charge)),
            pct_missing = (missing_statute_charge / n) * 100)

```


```{r}

dat <- encounters_latest |>
  group_by(source_file, source_sheet) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            missing_statute_charge = sum(is.na(statute_charge)),
            pct_missing = (missing_statute_charge / n) * 100)

```

## Exploration

### USBP Apprehension Counts Over Time

```{r}
monthly_counts <- apprehensions_edited |>
  filter(!is.na(apprehension_datetime)) |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(as.Date(apprehension_datetime), "month")) |>
  count(month, title_of_authority)

bracket_y <- max(monthly_counts$n) * 1.1

ggplot(monthly_counts, aes(month, n, color = title_of_authority)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = as.Date("2020-03-20"), xend = as.Date("2023-05-11"),
    y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y
  ) +
  annotate(
    "point",
    x = as.Date(c("2020-03-20", "2023-05-11")),
    y = bracket_y,
    shape = "|", size = 5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2021-10-14"), y = bracket_y * 1.05,
    label = "Title 42", size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Title 8" = "#0072B2", "Title 42" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Monthly apprehensions", color = "Assigned authority",
    title = "USBP apprehensions"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

```

-   I applied the same classification rule that labeled rows with any value in `statute_charge` as Title 8, NA `statute_charge` as Title 42, and all else as NA to `apprehensions_latest.parquet`.
-   These results lead me to think that `statute_charge` may not be a reliable indication of title of authority because that logic applied here implies that Title 42 exists in apprehensions, which we know not to be true.
- Note `statute_charge` is largely or entirely missing in some source datasets for apprehensions.

### Title 8 Encounter and Apprehension Comparison

```{r}
# Find overlapping date ranges
# min(apprehensions_edited$apprehension_datetime)
# max(apprehensions_edited$apprehension_datetime)
# min(encounters_edited$encounter_datetime)
# max(encounters_edited$encounter_datetime)

title_42_start_date <- as.Date("2020-03-20")
title_42_end_date <- as.Date("2023-05-11")

# Title 8 encounter count in comparable range
title8_enc_in_range <- encounters_edited |> filter(between(
  as.Date(encounter_datetime),
  as.Date(min(encounters_edited$encounter_datetime)), 
  as.Date(max(encounters_edited$encounter_datetime)))) |>
  summarise(sum(title_of_authority == "Title 8", na.rm = TRUE))

# Apprehension count in comparable range
app_in_range <-  apprehensions_edited |> filter(between(
  as.Date(apprehension_datetime),
  as.Date(min(encounters_edited$encounter_datetime)), 
  as.Date(max(encounters_edited$encounter_datetime)))) |>
  summarize(n = n())

# Title 42 encounter count in Title 42 period 
title_42_during_title_42_period <- encounters_edited |> filter(between(
  as.Date(encounter_datetime), 
  as.Date(title_42_start_date), 
  as.Date(title_42_end_date)))|>
  summarise(sum((title_of_authority == "Title 42"), na.rm = TRUE))

# Title 8 encounter count in Title 42 period 
title_8_during_title_42_period <- encounters_edited |> filter(between(
  as.Date(encounter_datetime), 
  as.Date(title_42_start_date), 
  as.Date(title_42_end_date))) |>
  summarise(sum(title_of_authority == "Title 8", na.rm = TRUE))

# Apprehension count in Title 42 period 
app_during_title_42_period <- apprehensions_edited |> filter(between(
  as.Date(apprehension_datetime),
  as.Date(title_42_start_date), 
  as.Date(title_42_end_date))) |>
  summarize(n = n())

```

-   I counted apprehensions and Title 8 encounters within the comparable period (largest period of coverage shared by both datasets) and the Title 42 period.
-   In the comparable period, the apprehensions dataset counts `{r} app_in_range` apprehensions, while the encounters dataset counts `{r} title8_enc_in_range` apprehensions. Assuming the apprehensions dataset is accurate, the logic under-counts apprehensions by `{r} app_in_range - title8_enc_in_range`.
-   In the Title 42 period, the apprehensions dataset counts `{r} app_during_title_42_period` apprehensions, while the encounters dataset counts only `{r} title_8_during_title_42_period` apprehensions. Assuming the apprehensions dataset is accurate during the Title 42 period, the logic under-counts apprehensions by `{r} app_during_title_42_period - title_8_during_title_42_period`.

### Title 42 CBP Dashboard Count Comparison

```{r}

official_t42 <- cross_reference_file |>
  filter(
    Component == "U.S. Border Patrol",
    `Title of Authority` == "Title 42"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_number = match(
      str_to_upper(`Month (abbv)`),
      str_to_upper(month.abb)
    ),
    calendar_year = as.integer(`Fiscal Year`) -
      if_else(month_number >= 10L, 1L, 0L),
    month = make_date(calendar_year, month_number, 1)
  ) |>
  filter(between(
    month,
    floor_date(title_42_start_date, "month"),
    floor_date(title_42_end_date, "month")
  )) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    official_title42 = sum(`Encounter Count`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

encounters_t42 <- encounters_edited |>
  filter(between(
    as.Date(encounter_datetime), title_42_start_date, title_42_end_date),
    title_of_authority == "Title 42"
  ) |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(as.Date(encounter_datetime), "month")) |>
  count(month, name = "assigned_title42")

comparison <- official_t42 |>
  left_join(encounters_t42, by = "month") |>
  mutate(
    difference = assigned_title42 - official_title42,
    pct_difference = 100 * (difference / na_if(official_title42, 0))
  )

print(comparison, n = Inf)
```

-   Percent differences seem negligible at first but generally grow by month throughout the Title 42 period.

```{r}
#| label: enc-title-42
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "CBP-reported Title 42 encounters versus assigned title of authority"
#| fig-subcap: 
#|   - "Totals"
#|   - "Difference"
#|   - "% Difference"
#| fig-cap-location: top

p1 <- comparison |>
  select(-c(difference, pct_difference)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(official_title42, assigned_title42)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = value, color = name)) +
  geom_line()

p1 + theme_minimal_transparent()

p2 <- comparison |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = difference)) +
  geom_line()

p2 + theme_minimal_transparent()

p3 <- comparison |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = pct_difference)) +
  geom_line()

p3 + theme_minimal_transparent()

```
